ai-companion-setup 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Comprehensive guide for building a Feishu-based AI companion agent using OpenClaw.
- Covers agent personality, heartbeat logic, memory system, message/voice/selfie sending scripts, and tool instructions.
- Includes setup details, pitfalls, cron configuration, and recommended model/provider notes.
- Designed for agents that can remember, speak, text, and send selfies with realistic persona.
